notes.title: 🚀 Update 1.2 - Cosmetics, SFX Update, & Hands!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Update 1.2 is Here! 🚀[/h1][p][/p][h2]🎩 Cosmetic System Added![/h2][p]✨ Up to [b]20 unlockable hats[/b] to collect!
💰 Find [b]coins[/b] hidden on each level.
🛒 Visit the [b]Cosmetic Shop[/b] through the [b]golden button in the elevator[/b].
🎨 Unlock [b]new skins[/b] to customize your Dreamer![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🖐️ First Person Hands[/h2][p]Immersion just got a huge boost — [b]hands are now visible in first-person view[/b]![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔊 Sound Effects Update[/h2][list][*][p]💀 When you die, your character may now [b]scream[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🧸 Your rag-doll body makes [b]satisfying slam sounds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]📏 [b]Rulers[/b] now… sound like actual rulers. Ruler’y as hell.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Minor Updates[/h2][list][*][p]📚 On Levels 1 & 2, [b]Lailah now teaches new Dreamers[/b] how to rotate and throw objects.[/p][/*][*][p]🏗️ [b]Level 29 completely reworked[/b] (the old one was… well, let’s just say it was crap 💩).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 Jump in, try on some hats, and see how many coins you can collect![/p]

tags.feature: ✨ Up to [b]20 unlockable hats[/b] to collect!

🧸 Your rag-doll body makes [b]satisfying slam sounds[/b].

🏗️ [b]Level 29 completely reworked[/b] (the old one was… well, let’s just say it was crap 💩).

notes.title: Update 1.1 Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]🔥 [b]Climb The Backrooms - Major Update LIVE NOW![/b] 🔥[/p][p]Dreamers, it's time to dive back in, right in time for the weekend![/p][p]We've just pushed a huge update packed with terrifying new content, smoother gameplay, and a few surprises lurking in the dark 👀[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/e8ee92f147de716692b5fe418257c68194bc227d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/cfe1323110ad182133ae94638bb27d4494266046.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/5d359b8b481ba86286c912b8168eea8de2e2e68b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/30554142526918ad28a3539424c6078ff7d381c6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/905110163c4547d3188ac02e81bfd771e943b2fc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/8fd73ed98523eae7f9ae386eb75b9afa95c79be7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/eb2e8251be84b2f07666366e05fb050347a66186.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/49ebf9e89b495a6ca31318264d7f8b31e8a347d1.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]🆕 Patch Highlights:[/b][/p][p]📍 [b]10 New Levels[/b] have replaced older, slower ones – faster, scarier, and way more intense[/p][p]🔸 [b]7 New Entities[/b] now haunt the halls:[/p][list][*][p]💧 [i]Water Entity[/i][/p][/*][*][p]📦 [i]Object Eater[/i][/p][/*][*][p]🔋 [i]Battery Boy[/i][/p][/*][*][p]❓ [i]Unknown Entity[/i] (x2)[/p][/*][*][p]☢️ [i]Hazmat Entity[/i][/p][/*][*][p]😊 [i]Mrs. Smile[/i] – don’t let the grin fool you[/p][/*][/list][p]🎮 [b]New Minigames[/b] have been added to ramp up the tension and fun[/p][p]😱 [b]Loads of new jump-scares[/b] – expect the unexpected[/p][p]🎥 [b]Streamers, we got you.[/b]
New [b]Streamer Mode[/b] is now available for a cleaner experience[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Performance & QoL Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Return to Lobby button ✅[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screens more consistent✅[/p][/*][*][p]New object pickup sounds ✅[/p][/*][*][p]General optimisation and smoother performance across the board[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Whether you’ve played before or are new to the nightmare, [b]there’s never been a better (or scarier) time to Climb.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]//Dev Note//[/i]
If you’ve played before, now’s the perfect time to return — with [b]Level Select[/b] in the lobby, you can dive straight into the new horrors. We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear:[/p][p]⚠️ Some mid-game levels dragged.
⚠️ Some just didn’t hit the mark.[/p][p]That changes [b]now[/b].[/p][p]We’ve completely [b]reworked the pacing and replaced slower levels[/b] with some of our [b]best-designed, most intense stages yet[/b]. They’re faster, scarier, and packed with surprises.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Play now — if you dare.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Sneak Peak | Update 1.1
notes.content: [p][b]Update 1.1[/b] is shaping up to be something [i]really[/i] exciting—and it’s coming very soon.[/p][p]I’ve been working tirelessly on this next update—without rushing it, of course. There are some seriously fun and terrifying new additions on the way: new entities that’ll chase you down and scare the absolute life out of you, plus a full rework of [b]nine[/b] maps that are being completely redesigned from the ground up.[/p][p]Your feedback—good, bad, or brutal—is always appreciated and plays a big role in shaping each patch.[/p][p]If you’ve already played the game, I promise it’ll be worth coming back once this juicy update drops. I’d love to share some videos, but I don’t want to spoil too much just yet 😏[/p][p]Here are a few pics and a little gif to give you a taste.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/e305c51a34820bcc725ddf5eb57888d318ac66d7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/e8ee92f147de716692b5fe418257c68194bc227d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/21122e5275d46136cf7138fc64f5684353b475fc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/12e2a812b0c91f4e4d17d24445ba9e733a28b12d.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Happy Climbing, Dreamers 💛[/p]
